text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on assembling a team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To start you off, I've prepared a
clubroom for you
all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I only managed to secure
the basic
necessities. There isn't even
enough training
equipment in there yet...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But as you increase your ranking by
securing
victories in the Unity Cup, I'm
sure we can find
some funds to improve
it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And those upgrades will in turn help
your team to
train harder and more
efficiently—I'm sure of it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to work diligently in the
Unity Cup for
your team's sake, so best
of luck!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All right, then! Let's get you signed up
for the
Unity Cup straight away.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Here's the registration paperwork.
Please fill it
out and submit it when you
can.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll be rooting for your success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a blank space on the form to
write our
team name. Perhaps "Team
Carrot" would be a
good choice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hm, the others suggested names for the
team
too, though...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's name our team...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I fill in our name on the form as "Happy
Hoppers."
That makes it official!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

show
everyone what we can do!
